The full raw census is host-only evidence and is not an extra generic bootstrap read role. Existing fixed16..20 object table remains unchanged. Any W operation needing a raw group body has no new read permission; actual H validation/source qualification is mandatory.
capacity: Before full census, bound four passes, up to4096 directories/aggregateIDs/depth64, fixed raw reads per group and six per thread, all source parse/retained/capture/readback/EOF/descriptor/iterator costs plus group/start/Ack/carrier. Source existing raw limits8192stat/65536status/membership remain ceilings, not allowances. Canonical full record and every raw member must fit original per-file/member/depth/read/write/CPU/wall/retained budgets; reject infeasible population before effect, no chunk/truncate/drop/count-only substitute. Raw text captures use original bounded Store exact write/readback; actual H retains each source-owned capture, not new user Pins.

Retain all earlier raw captures and unknowns; later diagnostics cannot replace first error. Cleanup independently under original H E, no new attempt/recapture; worker no model/server work while waiting.
